tagline: Leading owner and operator of industrial real estate properties with strong portfolio fundamentals and tenant demand
hero_kpi_rationale: Total revenue is the primary indicator of the size and growth of the company's business in the industrial real estate sector. It reflects the company's ability to generate rental and other income from its property portfolio.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of revenue generated by the company during a fiscal year.
kpis.description: Represents all income from properties in operation, acquired, sold, under development, and other sources.
kpis.signal: Strong revenue growth, driven by acquisitions and developments.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold or services rendered.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue, indicating profitability of core operations.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of total revenue.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Total amount of capital spending for the acquisition or improvement of physical assets.
kpis.description: Represents funds used to acquire or improve long-term assets, such as real estate properties under development.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.

kpis.name: Increase in Lease Rates on Services
kpis.explanation: Increase in average lease rates applied to new and renewed leases.
kpis.description: Indicates higher rental income on leases that commenced or were renewed, reflecting healthy demand.
kpis.signal: Strong increase in lease rates, signaling strong market demand.

kpis.name: Tenant Retention Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of tenants who renew their leases.
kpis.description: Measures the company's ability to retain existing tenants, an indicator of revenue stability.
kpis.signal: Strong retention rate, indicating tenant satisfaction.

kpis.name: Year-End Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of gross leasable area occupied by tenants at the end of the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Indicates the utilization level of the real estate portfolio, a key factor for rental income.
kpis.signal: High occupancy rate, reflecting strong demand for industrial properties.

kpis.name: Gross Leasable Area
kpis.explanation: Total area of the company's properties available for lease to tenants.
kpis.description: Represents the total size of the real estate portfolio available for leasing, consisting of 414 properties.
kpis.signal: Substantial and growing real estate portfolio.

kpis.name: Revenue from Acquired Properties
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by properties acquired during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: This KPI shows the impact of recent acquisitions on the company's financial performance.
kpis.signal: Exponential growth in revenue from recent acquisitions.

kpis.name: Revenue from Sold Properties
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by properties sold during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: This KPI indicates the contribution of asset sales to total revenue, showing a decline compared to the prior year.
kpis.signal: Significant decrease in revenue from sold properties, reflecting a divestiture strategy.

kpis.name: Revenue from Developments and Redevelopments
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by properties under development or redevelopment.
kpis.description: This KPI highlights the growing contribution of new projects to revenue generation.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in revenue from development projects, indicating portfolio expansion.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Economic Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Position in the 10-K, intensity of language, context vs prior year

risks.title: Real Estate Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition for real estate investments, high prices

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K report for the 2025 fiscal year. No references to AI are present in the provided excerpts.
